usage_collection.AbstractUsageLogger

Abstract class for usage loggers. Should be implemented by the user.

Available as lseg.data.usage_collection.AbstractUsageLogger.

Syntax

AbstractUsageLogger(*args, **kwargs)

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
*args No Positional arguments passed when the logger is added to the usage logger.
**kwargs No Keyword arguments passed when the logger is added to the usage logger.

Methods

close

Closes the logger. Called when the usage logger is stopped, after the last batch has been logged.

close() -> None

Returns

None

log

Handles a batch of usage records.

log(batch: list[LogRecord]) -> None

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
batch list[LogRecord] Yes Records to log, filtered by the filters the logger was added with.

Returns

None

Related types

LogRecord

This class is used to store record, with filter used by logger and name of the record.

Available as lseg.data.usage_collection.LogRecord.

Syntax
LogRecord(
    name: str,
    func_path: str,
    data: RecordData,
    filter: set[FilterType] = <factory>,
    timestamp: float = <factory>,
) -> None
Parameters
Parameter Type Required Default Description
name str Yes Name of the record.
func_path str Yes Path of the logged function.
data RecordData Yes Arguments and result of the logged call.
filter set[FilterType] No <factory> Filter types of the record, matched against the filters of the loggers.
timestamp float No <factory> UTC timestamp of the record creation; set automatically by default.
